findings.problem: The example uses the Perfekt participle angegriffen, so it never shows the separable verb split, which the card rules require.
findings.fix: example.target: Pass auf, der Hund greift Fremde an! | example.en: Watch out, the dog attacks strangers!

note: attackieren also exists, but angreifen is the standard everyday word, so the prompt doesn't need a hint.
